description: Lists RestaurantDoctorAI's daily kitchen walk checklist: 12 things a manager can check in the walk-in cooler and on the prep line (cold food at 41°F or below, hot food at 135°F or above, raw animal foods stored below or away from ready-to-eat food, date marking, food covered and off the floor, labeled containers, the hand sink, sanitizer strength and chemical storage), each with a question to ask, the rule in plain words and the FDA Food Code 2022 sections it comes from. area narrows it to the cooler or the line. It's a self-check, not an inspection, and says nothing about whether any food is safe; state and local health departments adopt the Food Code with their own changes. Nothing about the request is stored or counted.

area.description: Which part of the kitchen: cooler (the walk-in and other cold storage), line (the prep line), or all (the default).

name: restaurantdoctor_walk_checklist

question.description: What to ask the manager, who shows it and answers.

rule.description: The rule in plain words, from the Food Code's text.

sections.description: Where it is in the FDA Food Code 2022.

anyOf.description: For a holding temperature: the Food Code's figure in degrees Fahrenheit.
Which side of the figure the food belongs on.

title: Kitchen walk checklist
